description: This header defines utilities for creating and working with seed sequences in the Abseil C++ library, including the `absl::SeedSeq` class, functions to create seed sequences from bit generators, and to generate salted seed sequences for reproducible randomness.

classes.name: absl::SeedSeq
classes.description: A salted seed sequence class used for generating non-deterministic seed sequences for bit generators.

methods.name: absl::CreateSeedSeqFrom
methods.description: Creates a seed sequence from a given bit generator, extracting seed material.

methods.name: absl::MakeSeedSeq
methods.description: Generates a salted seed sequence with implementation-defined entropy for creating correlated bit generators.
